en:
<CLT=cltMIND>The greenery is completely gone.
This place really feels mechanical now.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like construction is almost done,
but what happens then?

An <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Academy<CLT=cltNORMAL>, the likes
of which we've never seen before...
Will we ever find out what that means?

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item, the vine suddenly
withered... How does that work?
<CLT=cltMIND>So this is the key to the gate...
